title: Write the physical objective · Set 2
statement:
An open-top box uses a square sheet with side $6([$a])$. Find its maximum volume.

[__________]{a}
hints: Find the only interior critical number $x=a$.
Evaluate the volume after subtracting the cut from both ends.
solution: The endpoints have zero volume. The maximum is at $x=[$a]$ and equals $([$a])(4[$a])^2=16([$a])^3$.

feedback.message: Evaluate the volume after subtracting the cut from both ends.
